description: Reworks a composite type's fields — one widened, one dropped, one added — while a second type stays in use by a table. Fields match by name, so renaming one is indistinguishable from dropping it and adding another. The type under change is deliberately unused: altering one a column is typed by is refused by Postgres and NSchema does not yet say so.

sqlserver.because: SQL Server has no composite type, so the scenario's bootstrap state cannot be expressed.

sqlite.because: SQLite has no composite type, so the scenario's bootstrap state cannot be expressed.
